The number of threads that[`<OffthreadVideo>`](/docs/offthreadvideo) can start to extract frames. The default is 2. Increase carefully, as too many threads may cause instability.

## CLI flag

Use `--offthreadvideo-video-threads` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                     | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)       | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)       | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--offthreadvideo-video-threads <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`getCompositionsOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/getcompositionsonlambda#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`getCompositions()`](/docs/renderer/get-compositions#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#offthreadvideothreads)
- [`selectComposition()`](/docs/renderer/select-composition#offthreadvideothreads)
